coverage.rounds: All 34 matchdays (306 official fixture pairings) retrieved. Results: R1–R5 complete plus 7 completed R6 matches through 17 Oct. Two R6 Sunday fixtures are unfinished at cutoff; all other future rows are schedule-only.

Future pairings are taken only from official Bundesliga matchday pages; where the source only publishes a round date range, the individual date is left blank. Rounds without a published date on the captured pages: 16,24. Range-only matchdays: 12,13,14,15,17,18,19,20,21,22,23,25,26,27,28,29,30,31,32,33.

rules.qualification: Official Bundesliga allocation for 2026/27: positions 1–4 Champions League, positions 5–6 Europa League, position 7 Conference League qualification play-offs; this is confirmed by the official list of the seven 2026/27 qualifiers. Cup and UEFA titleholder/association-slot rules can alter allocation in other seasons.
rules.relegation: Positions 17–18 are directly relegated; position 16 contests a two-leg playoff against the 2. Bundesliga third-place club. Official Bundesliga FAQ.
